title: vsnip-check folder settings
description: Extends NIP validation and completion for files in this folder and its subfolders. Lists add to the vsnip-check.* settings and to .vsnip.json files in parent folders; set "root": true to leave the parent files out.

root.description: Ignore .vsnip.json files in parent folders. The vsnip-check.* settings still apply.

additionalProperties.description: Additional valid NIP properties to accept in the first section.

additionalStats.description: Additional valid NIP stats to accept in the second section.

additionalExtras.description: Additional valid NIP extras to accept in extra sections.
